events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors will support write, update and delete actions

events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
events.titleJa: Microsoft 365 Copilot チャットで Planner のタスク・プラン管理に対応
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
events.summary: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.
events.summaryJa: Microsoft 365 Copilot チャットで Planner のタスクやプランを作成し、Planner の情報を検索できるようになります。Copilot と Planner の間で、タスクやプランをシームレスに管理できます。
events.summaryEn: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Education] Create multi-week unit plans with Teach
events.titleJa: [教育] Teach で複数週にわたる単元計画を作成
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Education] Create multi-week unit plans with Teach
events.summary: Educators can use Teach in Microsoft 365 Copilot to create structured unit plans that span multiple lessons or weeks. They can customize the plan components to organize connected lesson plans and quizzes across a unit. #education
events.summaryJa: 教育者は Microsoft 365 Copilot の Teach を使って、複数の授業または複数週にわたる体系的な単元計画を作成できます。計画の構成要素を調整し、単元内の関連する授業案やクイズを整理できます。
events.summaryEn: Educators can use Teach in Microsoft 365 Copilot to create structured unit plans that span multiple lessons or weeks. They can customize the plan components to organize connected lesson plans and quizzes across a unit. #education
